metadata.title: Django Azure Security Template - Zero Trust Component Definition

props.name: role
props.value: Systems Engineer / Security Junior Adoption Program

components.title: DeviceVerificationMiddleware
components.description: Application-layer Zero Trust Policy Enforcement Point. Performs device fingerprinting via User-Agent analysis, detects IP address changes, and flags suspicious scanning tools (sqlmap, nikto, nmap) at request time.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls implemented by application-layer device verification

implemented-requirements.description: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users) is reinforced through continuous device-context verification beyond initial login, per Zero Trust Policy Enforcement Point pattern from NIST SP 800-207.
System Monitoring: real-time detection of scanning tool signatures (sqlmap, nikto, nmap) in User-Agent headers, logged to AppTraces for Sentinel correlation.
Account Management: IP-address-change detection supports anomalous session identification for authenticated accounts.

components.title: Azure Key Vault + System-Assigned Managed Identity
components.description: Centralized secrets management with RBAC-based access control, no credentials in code or environment variables. Access enforced via Managed Identity, not static secrets.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls implemented by centralized secrets management

implemented-requirements.description: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management via Azure Key Vault with Private Endpoint isolation.
Access Enforcement: Key Vault Secrets User role assignment scoped to System-Assigned MSI only, enforcing least-privilege access to secrets.

Authenticator Management: no static credentials stored in code, environment variables, or CI/CD secrets for accessing application secrets; Managed Identity token exchange replaces long-lived credentials.

components.title: Microsoft Sentinel Analytics Rules
components.description: Scheduled KQL-based detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, correlating Defender for Cloud alerts and application-layer telemetry into Sentinel incidents.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls implemented by continuous automated detection

implemented-requirements.description: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting: automated correlation via BuiltInFusion (cross-signal ML) and scheduled Analytics Rules (zero-trust-device-verification, defender-active-scanning-nmap).
System Monitoring: kernel-level scan detection (Defender for App Service) correlated with application-layer signals, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK T1595/T1046/T1078/T1036.
Incident Handling: automated incident creation with AllEntities grouping and lookback correlation (PT1H/PT5M) upon rule trigger.

components.title: VNet Segmentation + NSG Deny-All + Private Endpoints
components.description: Three-subnet VNet (app/data/kv) with NSG default-deny posture and Private Endpoints isolating Key Vault and PostgreSQL from public network access.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls implemented by network segmentation, aligned to NIST SP 800-207 micro-segmentation principle

implemented-requirements.description: Boundary Protection: NSG deny-all default with explicit allow on 443; Private Endpoints remove Key Vault and PostgreSQL from the public network boundary entirely.
System Partitioning: three-subnet segmentation (app-subnet, data-subnet, kv-subnet) separating application, data, and secrets tiers.
